items.title: What a jump in implied correlation means for markets and the dispersion trade
items.summary: Investing.com -- The 1-month 50-delta implied correlation gauge added 7 points to move above 30, its highest intraday level since early April, according to a report from Bloomberg. High implied correlation means options markets expect stocks to move together. In practice, that is what indiscriminate, forced selling looks like: investors sell everything at once, whatever the fundamentals.
